propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui hodierna die beatum Henricum Confessorem tuum e terreni culmine
imperii ad regnum aeternum transtulisti: te supplices exoramus; ut, sicut
illum, gratiae tuae ubertate praeventum, illecebras saeculi superare
fecisti, ita nos facias, ejus imitatione, mundi hujus blandimenta vitare, et
ad te puris mentibus pervenire. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium
tuum: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

translations.text: O God, Who on this day didst remove blessed Henry, Thy confessor, from the crown of an earthly empire to an everlasting kingdom, we humbly beseech Thee that, as, protected by the abundance of Thy grace, Thou didst enable him to overcome the temptations of the world, so Thou make us, in imitation of him, to avoid the allurements of this world and to come with pure minds unto Thee. Through our Lord.
